description: Header file defining the ul_pucch_pdu_builder class, which provides methods to construct and configure PUCCH PDU messages, including setting parameters and building specific formats.

classes.name: ul_pucch_pdu_builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing and configuring ul_pucch_pdu objects, supporting setting parameters and building different PUCCH formats.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets the UE-specific parameters in the PUCCH PDU.

methods.name: get_pucch_format_0_builder
methods.description: Returns a builder for PUCCH format 0 PDU.

methods.name: get_pucch_format_1_builder
methods.description: Returns a builder for PUCCH format 1 PDU.

methods.name: get_pucch_format_2_builder
methods.description: Returns a builder for PUCCH format 2 PDU.

methods.name: get_pucch_format_3_builder
methods.description: Returns a builder for PUCCH format 3 PDU.

methods.name: get_pucch_format_4_builder
methods.description: Returns a builder for PUCCH format 4 PDU.

methods.name: set_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets bandwidth part parameters in the PDU.

methods.name: set_frequency_allocation_parameters
methods.description: Sets frequency allocation parameters in the PDU.

methods.name: set_time_allocation_parameters
methods.description: Sets time allocation parameters in the PDU.

methods.name: set_hopping_information_parameters
methods.description: Sets hopping information parameters in the PDU.
